scope: GenAI webpage only; native relay retained; no independent official API

confirmed_findings.finding: Natural empty generation originates in the school webpage SSE
confirmed_findings.limit: This recaptures the same failure class with real omp and failed-history copies; historical failures without raw SSE cannot all be retroactively assigned the same internal cause.

confirmed_findings.finding: First hop previously treated empty stop as a successful completion; relay rejected it only later
confirmed_findings.fix: First-hop visible-answer validation and exactly one continuation for fully empty normal stops on tool-enabled requests

confirmed_findings.finding: Relay erased structured first-hop failure details
confirmed_findings.old_error: First-hop service returned a stream error
confirmed_findings.fix: Safe message/type/code retained for all protocols, streaming and HTTP failures, with bounded error bodies and credential masking
confirmed_findings.limit: The old Kimi stream failures cannot now be retrospectively distinguished as validation, parsing, or network faults.

protocol_ablation.conclusion: Single stochastic variants do not isolate a causal field. Original input can succeed again; disabling thinking does not eliminate empty stop. No concurrency serialization, session nonce, budget clamp, or global thinking change was shipped.

recovery_invariants.next_question: Original question plus an explicit continuation instruction; not an identical blind replay

live_failure_history_rechecks.note: No natural empty response occurred in this particular three-task repaired sample; it is not evidence that platform empties have ceased.

recorded_fault_injection.first_response: Previously captured real empty SSE recording, deliberately injected

task14_stopped_safely.message: Action envelope contains invalid or incomplete JSON
task14_stopped_safely.raw_model_json_error: Expecting property name enclosed in double quotes

extended_natural_recovery_trace.interpretation: Two real empty stops recovered without a user restart. This investigation trace is not a passed business campaign: it later rejected genuinely malformed JSON, and independent verification found a model-generated business error.

retention.decision: User approved keeping six core evidence groups; temporary scripts, isolated caches, preliminary replays and short pilots were removed

excluded_evidence: Initial hand-built schema replays omitted omp's required i field and caused artificial schema errors; they are not used to diagnose the original failures
Delimiter collisions and unclosed Markdown quotation risks had no observed triggering evidence; no permissive parsing was added
limits: The school inference service's internal reason for empty stop remains outside available evidence
Typed errors and bounded recovery do not prove arbitrary-hour unattended stability
Rechecks use copies of retained failed sessions and projects; they are not matched old/new end-to-end endurance A/B tests
